questions.question: What does Psalm 135 contrast with the living God?
options: The mighty kings of the earth, gathered in their pride
The proud rulers of Egypt, who oppressed the people
The false prophets of Israel, speaking their own dreams
The lifeless idols of the nations, made by human hands
questions.answer: The lifeless idols of the nations, made by human hands
